lead_with.title: Build it in from day one
lead_with.text: Clockwork is a **new label**. It is easier to set up carbon measurement and sustainable practices now than to change habits later.

lead_with.title: Light for a small team
lead_with.text: **Secoset®** centralises data, and Flying Secoya's **eco-managers** do the work on set. No extra burden on a lean label team.

lead_with.title: International co-productions
lead_with.text: Specialty films often shoot or co-produce in Europe, where carbon reporting is more common. Flying Secoya already works there (exact requirements per country **to be confirmed**).

company.text: Clockwork is a **specialty film label launched by Warner Bros. in April 2026**, led by former Neon executives Christian Parkes, Jason Wald and Spencer Collantes. Its first announced project is **Sean Baker's 'Ti Amo!'**. Warner Bros. is part of **Warner Bros. Discovery**. Clockwork's size, budget levels and production slate beyond 'Ti Amo!' are **to be confirmed**.

talking_points: Congratulations on the launch of Clockwork: what kind of films will you make and buy?
How many productions do you expect per year, and where will they shoot?
Does Warner Bros. ask its labels for **carbon or sustainability reporting** today?
Would a **pilot on one production** (carbon footprint + eco-manager) be useful for 'Ti Amo!' or the next film?
Who else should join: Warner Bros. sustainability team or line producers?

attention.title: Acquisitions vs production.
attention.text: On acquired films, Clockwork does not run the shoot. Focus on films it **produces**.

attention.title: Parent company processes.
attention.text: Warner Bros. may already have a group sustainability program (to be confirmed). Position Flying Secoya as a help, not a replacement.

attention.title: Do not wait.
attention.text: He said yes on LinkedIn: send the email quickly while interest is fresh.
